{"note": "Box (back housing) for a wall-mounted Adafruit DotStar 255-LED disc. The disc screws onto a front flange with two M3x8 screws through its measured 33.5-mm-pitch mounting holes; the perfboard+ESP32 mount inside on four printed standoffs using the person's own M2x6 self-tapping screws; two keyhole slots hang the box on wall screws; a slot in the top wall lets a USB-C plug reach the ESP32 port. 0 = up (+y)"}, "box_wall_t": {"value": 3.0, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}, "box_void_depth": {"value": 30.0, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}, "disc_clearance": {"value": 6.0, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}, "keyhole_id_top": {"value": 5.5, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}, "keyhole_slot_l": {"value": 8.0, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}, "wall_screw_pitch": {"value": 160.0, "unit": "mm", "kind": "design", "source": "design"}}, "parts": [{"id": "box", "role": "final", "material": "PLA (matte white)", "code": "def build(p):
    import math
    R = p['disc_od']/2.0 + p['disc_clearance']
    wall = p['box_wall_t']
    depth = p['box_void_depth'] + wall
    box = (cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(depth))
    box = (box.faces('>Z').workplane().circle(R - wall).cutBlind(-depth + wall))
    flange_t = 2.5
    flange = (cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(flange_t))
    half = p['disc_hole_pitch']/2.0
    rad = p['disc_hole_d']/2.0 + 0.4
    flange = (flange.faces('>Z').workplane().pushPoints([(half,0),(-half,0)]).hole(rad*2))
    box = box.union(flange)
    inset = p['perf_hole_inset']
    l, w = p['perf_l'], p['perf_w']
    cx, cy = l/2.0 - inset, w/2.0 - inset
    pts = [(cx,cy),(-cx,cy),(-cx,-cy),(cx,-cy)]
    sh = p['esp32_h'] + p['perf_t'] + 2.0
    box = (box.faces('<Z').workplane().pushPoints(pts)
           .circle(p['perf_hole_d']/2.0 + 1.0).extrude(sh))
    box = (box.faces('<Z').workplane().pushPoints(pts).hole(1.6, sh))
    box = (box.faces('>Z').workplane().pushPoints([(p['wall_screw_pitch']/2.0,0),(-p['wall_screw_pitch']/2.0,0)]).slot2D(p['keyhole_slot_l'], p['keyhole_id_top'], 0))
    box = (box.faces('>Y').workplane().center(0, p['usb_recep_bottom'] + p['usb_recep_h']/2.0).slot2D(20.0, p['usb_recep_h'] + 4.0, 0).cutBlind(-wall))
    return box", "print_orientation": "back wall (-z face) flat on the bed, void and flange facing up", "use_orientation": "back wall against the wall; +z out toward the disc; +y up"}], "hardware": [{"id": "disc_screw", "ref": "ISO 4762 M3x8", "qty": 2}, {"id": "led_disk", "ref": "own:led-disk"}, {"id": "pboard", "ref": "own:perfboard"}, {"id": "esp32", "ref": "own:esp32"}], "joints": [{"id": "disc_mount_1", "fastener": "disc_screw", "axis_origin": [16.75, 0, 2.5], "axis_dir": [0, 0, -1], "seats": [{"part": "box", "feature": "front flange M3 hole at +x", "role": "clearance"}, {"part": "box", "feature": "front flange M3 hole at +x", "role": "head_seat"}], "nut": null, "external": null}, {"id": "disc_mount_2", "fastener": "disc_screw", "axis_origin": [-16.75, 0, 2.5], "axis_dir": [0, 0, -1], "seats": [{"part": "box", "feature": "front flange M3 hole at -x", "role": "clearance"}], "nut": null, "external": null}], "criteria": [{"id": "disc_seats", "part": "box", "feature": "front flange M3 holes", "relation": "seats", "hardware": "disc_screw", "clearance_mm": 0.4, "params": ["disc_hole_pitch", "disc_hole_d", "disc_hole_pair_angle"], "check": {"method": "coupon", "ref": "disc_hole_coupon", "description": "Print a thin plate with two M3 holes at the measured pitch; dry-fit the disc to confirm screws pass and the disc sits flush."}}], "manual": [{"n": "1", "text": "Print the box (back wall flat on the bed).", "parts": ["box"]}, {"n": "2", "text": "Test the disc mount: place the disc on the front flange and confirm its two holes line up with the box's M3 holes.", "parts": ["box"], "hardware": ["disc_screw"]}, {"n": "3", "text": "Press four of your own M2x6 self-tapping screws up through the perfboard's corner holes into the four printed standoff pilots, ESP32 facing forward.", "parts": ["box"]}, {"n": "4", "text": "Route the four wires from the perfboard to the disc's input connector at 12 o'clock, tucking slack into the void.", "parts": ["box"]}, {"n": "5", "text": "Screw the disc onto the front flange with two M3x8 screws through the disc's holes.", "parts": ["box"], "hardware": ["disc_screw"]}, {"n": "6", "text": "Plug a USB-C cable through the side slot into the ESP32 port;
